name: Burgenwelt Ehrenberg
kurzbeschreibung: Burgenwelt Ehrenberg near Reutte features four historical fortress complexes, an interactive museum, and the highline179 suspension bridge.
preis: Fortress grounds free; highline179, inclined elevator & museum admission extra
oeffnungszeiten: Open daily year-round; museum 09:00 to 18:00; highline179 open 08:00 to 22:00
beschreibung:
Overview

The internationally renowned Burgenwelt Ehrenberg south of Reutte in the Tyrolean Außerfern is one of the most monumental and historically important fortification ensembles in Central Europe. The complex consists of four interconnected fortifications: the Gothic castle ruin Ehrenberg (around 1290), the baroque Klause barrier on the valley floor, Fort Claudia, and the high citadel Schlosskopf. For centuries, this fortified valley basin served as an impregnable military barrier on the crucial salt and commercial trade route between Germany and Italy. Today, Burgenwelt thrills cultural travelers and adventurers alike: alongside the experiential museum 'In the Footsteps of the Knight', the spectacular pedestrian suspension bridge 'highline179' spans dizzying depths of 114 meters, connecting Ehrenberg with Fort Claudia.

Route & Requirements

From the valley base at the Klause with its large parking area, visitor centre, and museum, guests can either hike up to the Ehrenberg castle ruin along well-maintained switchback forest trails (approx. 30 minutes, 110 meters of elevation) or ride the modern 'Ehrenberg Liner' inclined elevator. The panoramic lift carries visitors comfortably and barrier-free directly to the portal of highline179 and the castle ruin. For exploring the extensive fortification grounds, particularly the climb up to Fortress Schlosskopf, solid hiking shoes with profiled soles and steady footwork are mandatory. Crossing the 406-meter-long highline179 requires absolute freedom from vertigo; the bridge is secured with robust steel gratings and high safety mesh. The museum and valley tavern are fully level and family-friendly.

Visit & Arrival

Burgenwelt Ehrenberg, the museum, and the inclined lift operate daily year-round (summer 09:00 to 18:00, winter until 17:00). The pedestrian suspension bridge highline179 is accessible daily from 08:00 to 22:00. Motorists travel via the toll-free Fernpassstraße B179 directly to Reutte Süd (spacious paid parking on site). By rail, take the Außerfern Railway to Reutte in Tirol station and board regional bus 150 running directly to the Ehrenberger Klause stop.

Tips

Experience highline179 in the evening hours when the suspension cables and ancient castle walls are illuminated in warm light. Participate in the interactive knight rally inside the museum, where children can try on replica medieval armour and discover castle lore through play.
